skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of databases, data models, and database management systems.
Understand and explain relationships within databases, normalize data up to 3NF.
Apply theories, models, relational algebra expressions, and SQL syntax to analyze, evaluate, and explain query optimization and data integrity issues.
Understand and use MS SQL Server database management system.
Design databases according to normalization standards and apply basic principles of database design processes for operational activities.
Approach different database models and have analytical, advisory, and supportive skills for digital transformation processes.
Work independently or actively, positively, and effectively in group activities.
Have organizational skills for group activities.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information systems management.
